column1: # Outcomes of an unreadable row <sub>/policy. A row: path<TAB>reader<TAB>outcome<TAB>priority<TAB>unit<TAB>norm.
# path — the refusal path (JSON Pointer; "" — the whole row); priority — smaller is earlier; unit — the unit of unreadability.

column3: the whole row is unreadable (another value of `servers` or another key): the controller takes the manifest's default `placement.servers`, not a refusal; no `servers` — the same; the explicit norm P/04 N1.3 — the manifest's default placement.servers (a safe value, not «empty»)

the whole row is unreadable (another value of `servers` or another key): the console — the effective value of `GET /policy` (N2.1) — the manifest's default `placement.servers` (P/04 N1.3), not a refusal; no `servers` — the same

revision is unreadable: only the console reads it — the row stays, in the door's answer revision 0, the next write writes 1 (P/06.6 N2.1 «Row revision»); other readers do not read the field and do not reject the row
